items.title: 68163_Tom Whaley oral history interview
items.q: I played a number on the tape yesterday and it started with Harold a saxophone. I think Ashby was playing it... before the whole band got in there.

ctx.x: Yeah. The way it sounded to him, so I played a number on the tape yesterday and it started with Harold a saxophone. I think Ashby was playing it, / Ashby, yeah, he was playing it and it was a long while before the whole band got in there.
Were you still copying when Ashby was in there. That's way after Bill left him.
